text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne higher on CBOT soycomplex calls and hot, dry weather on the Prairies. Traders watching for fund buying to resume after funds bought 1,000 November Tuesday. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -8.31 Tuesday from -7.79 Monday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3757, fell to 83.62 yen and rose to 1.3287 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on spill over support with expected commercial bear spreading of Sep-Jan and Nov-Jan.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 a tonne up on CBOT corn calls and watching weather.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 higher on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
